atsSubtitle: Why clear structure matters for recruitment software
atsExplanationText: Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) parse resumes into structured candidate profiles. Our ATS-oriented templates prioritize single-column flow, standard headings, and clean text strings to maximize readability. Parsing behavior may vary between recruitment platforms.
atsDisclaimer: Note: While our templates adhere to ATS design best practices, interview invitations depend on your qualifications and employer selection criteria.
privacySubtitle: Your career data belongs strictly to you
privacyPoint1Desc: All draft updates write directly to your local browser storage.
privacyPoint2Desc: Mock intelligence features execute locally without sending resume content to external servers.
faqDesc: Everything you need to know about CV Platform.

q1.question: Is the resume document written in English?
q1.answer: Yes. The application UI supports both Arabic and English, but resume document content is strictly English and LTR only to maintain global standards.

q2.question: Does the platform support Arabic interface?
q2.answer: Yes! You can switch the entire application interface to Arabic (RTL) or English (LTR) at any time from the top navigation.

q3.question: Are my resume drafts saved automatically?
q3.answer: Yes. Drafts are automatically saved to your browser's localStorage using a debounced autosave mechanism.

q4.question: Are the AI analysis and job matching real external services?
q4.answer: Currently, analysis, matching, and text improvement run via deterministic local mock services as part of our front-end SaaS demonstration.

q5.question: How is the PDF document exported?
q5.answer: PDF export uses your browser's native print interface (window.print()). Selecting 'Save as PDF' generates a clean A4 PDF file with selectable text.

q6.question: Does using these templates guarantee job interviews?
q6.answer: No software can guarantee interviews. Our templates are designed for high readability and ATS best practices, but hiring decisions depend on employer criteria.
